title: Anti-Join
description: Find customers who have NEVER placed an order. Use three different techniques: LEFT JOIN + IS NULL, NOT IN, and NOT EXISTS. Results should be the same.
hints: Technique 1: LEFT JOIN orders ON ... WHERE order_id IS NULL
Technique 2: WHERE customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL)
Technique 3: WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders WHERE orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id)
